# Generated by scripts/kehillah_writing_sparks.py. Do not edit by hand.

kehillah_spark_clear_parshanut_effect = {
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_form
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_tier
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_work
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_base
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_apt
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_ready_told
	clear_variable_list = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_did_preached
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_did_chavrusa
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_did_ruled
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_did_answered
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_did_debated
}
kehillah_spark_clear_talmudics_effect = {
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_form
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_tier
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_work
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_base
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_apt
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_ready_told
	clear_variable_list = kehillah_spark_talmudics_paths
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_did_preached
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_did_chavrusa
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_did_ruled
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_did_answered
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_did_debated
}
kehillah_spark_clear_hashkafa_effect = {
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_form
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_tier
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_work
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_base

}

# Scope: a writer. FORM's slot takes a fresh Insight; WORK is its source or flag:none.
kehillah_spark_set_torah_effect = {
	kehillah_spark_clear_parshanut_effect = yes
	set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_form value = flag:torah }
	set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_tier value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_work value = $WORK$ }
	set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_base value = kehillah_writing_parshanut_mastered_value }
	set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_apt value = kehillah_writing_parshanut_aptitude_value }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_known target = flag:torah } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_known target = flag:torah } }
	if = { limit = { is_ai = no } send_interface_toast = { type = event_toast_text_good title = kehillah_spark_new_toast_t desc = kehillah_spark_new_parshanut_toast left_icon = this } }
}

# Scope: a writer. Offer an Insight in FORM: an empty slot takes it; a slot
# holding another form asks the player (AI keeps what it has).
kehillah_spark_offer_torah_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_torah_trigger = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_form } }
			kehillah_spark_set_torah_effect = { WORK = $WORK$ }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no NOT = { kehillah_spark_holds_torah_trigger = yes } NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_pending_form } }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_pending_form value = flag:torah days = 60 }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_pending_work value = $WORK$ days = 60 }
			trigger_event = { id = kehillah_spark.0002 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}
kehillah_spark_offer_midrash_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_midrash_trigger = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_form } }
			kehillah_spark_set_midrash_effect = { WORK = $WORK$ }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no NOT = { kehillah_spark_holds_midrash_trigger = yes } NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_pending_form } }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_pending_form value = flag:midrash days = 60 }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_pending_work value = $WORK$ days = 60 }
			trigger_event = { id = kehillah_spark.0002 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}
kehillah_spark_offer_poetry_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_poetry_trigger = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_form } }
			kehillah_spark_set_poetry_effect = { WORK = $WORK$ }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no NOT = { kehillah_spark_holds_poetry_trigger = yes } NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_pending_form } }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_pending_form value = flag:poetry days = 60 }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_pending_work value = $WORK$ days = 60 }
			trigger_event = { id = kehillah_spark.0002 days = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# The player takes up the pending idea (kehillah_spark.0002).
kehillah_spark_take_pending_effect = {
	if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:torah } kehillah_spark_set_torah_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:midrash } kehillah_spark_set_midrash_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:poetry } kehillah_spark_set_poetry_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:grammar } kehillah_spark_set_grammar_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:chronicle } kehillah_spark_set_chronicle_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:talmud } kehillah_spark_set_talmud_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:yerushalmi } kehillah_spark_set_yerushalmi_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:law } kehillah_spark_set_law_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:responsa } kehillah_spark_set_responsa_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:minhag } kehillah_spark_set_minhag_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:siddur } kehillah_spark_set_siddur_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:tradition_history } kehillah_spark_set_tradition_history_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:scriptural_law } kehillah_spark_set_scriptural_law_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:dialogue } kehillah_spark_set_dialogue_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:systematic_dialogue } kehillah_spark_set_systematic_dialogue_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:mystical } kehillah_spark_set_mystical_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:disputation } kehillah_spark_set_disputation_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:translation } kehillah_spark_set_translation_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:ethics } kehillah_spark_set_ethics_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_spark_pending_form ?= flag:devotion } kehillah_spark_set_devotion_effect = { WORK = var:kehillah_spark_pending_work } }
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_pending_form
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_pending_work
}

kehillah_spark_refresh_paths_parshanut_effect = {
	clear_variable_list = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths
	set_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_torah_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_salmon_ben_jeroham_commentary_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_salmon_ben_jeroham_commentary } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_chronicle_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_sefer_yosippon_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_sefer_yosippon } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_torah_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_yefet_commentary_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_yefet_commentary } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_poetry_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_diwan_dunash_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_diwan_dunash } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_grammar_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_agron_david_al_fasi_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_agron_david_al_fasi } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_chronicle_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_cochin_copper_plates_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_cochin_copper_plates } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_poetry_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_diwan_samuel_hanagid_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_diwan_samuel_hanagid } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_poetry_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_diwan_ibn_gabirol_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_diwan_ibn_gabirol } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_torah_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_rashi_torah_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_rashi_torah } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_torah_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_ibn_ezra_torah_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_ibn_ezra_torah } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_torah_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_ramban_torah_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_ramban_torah } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_torah_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_sefer_hamivhar_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:work_sefer_hamivhar } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_form } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_paths target = flag:original_parshanut } }
}
kehillah_spark_ripen_parshanut_effect = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_form } kehillah_spark_refresh_paths_parshanut_effect = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_spark_can_upgrade_parshanut_trigger = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = yes }
			kehillah_spark_upgrade_parshanut_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_ready_told } }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_ready_told value = yes }
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } send_interface_toast = { type = event_toast_text_good title = kehillah_spark_ready_toast_t desc = kehillah_spark_ready_parshanut_toast left_icon = this } }
		}
	}
}
# The Upgrade button (scripted gui kehillah_spark_upgrade_parshanut).
kehillah_spark_upgrade_parshanut_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_spark_parshanut_tier ?= 1 kehillah_spark_can_deepen_parshanut_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_tier value = 2 }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } trigger_event = kehillah_spark.0011 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_spark_parshanut_tier ?= 2 kehillah_spark_can_be_great_parshanut_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_parshanut_tier value = 3 }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } trigger_event = kehillah_spark.0021 }
	}
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_ready_told
	kehillah_spark_refresh_paths_parshanut_effect = yes
}
# The card's discard button asks first (kehillah_spark.0031).
kehillah_spark_discard_parshanut_effect = { kehillah_spark_clear_parshanut_effect = yes }
kehillah_spark_refresh_paths_talmudics_effect = {
	clear_variable_list = kehillah_spark_talmudics_paths
	set_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_siddur_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_seder_rav_amram_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_talmudics_paths target = flag:work_seder_rav_amram } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_tradition_history_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_iggeret_rav_sherira_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_talmudics_paths target = flag:work_iggeret_rav_sherira } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_scriptural_law_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_levi_ben_yefet_mitzvot_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_talmudics_paths target = flag:work_levi_ben_yefet_mitzvot } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_talmud_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_rabbenu_hananel_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_talmudics_paths target = flag:work_rabbenu_hananel } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_law_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_hilkhot_harif_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_talmudics_paths target = flag:work_hilkhot_harif } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_talmud_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_rashi_talmud_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_talmudics_paths target = flag:work_rashi_talmud } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_talmud_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_tosafot_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_talmudics_paths target = flag:work_tosafot } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_law_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_mishneh_torah_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_talmudics_paths target = flag:work_mishneh_torah } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_minhag_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_teezaza_sanbat_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_talmudics_paths target = flag:work_teezaza_sanbat } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_law_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_sefer_mitzvot_gadol_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_talmudics_paths target = flag:work_sefer_mitzvot_gadol } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_law_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_or_zarua_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_talmudics_paths target = flag:work_or_zarua } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_law_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_sefer_hachinukh_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_talmudics_paths target = flag:work_sefer_hachinukh } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_law_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_arbaah_turim_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_talmudics_paths target = flag:work_arbaah_turim } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { local_var:kehillah_spark_paths_n < 3 kehillah_spark_holds_law_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_niche_shown_work_maggid_mishneh_trigger = yes } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_talmudics_paths target = flag:work_maggid_mishneh } change_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_paths_n add = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_form } add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_spark_talmudics_paths target = flag:original_talmudics } }
}
kehillah_spark_ripen_talmudics_effect = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_form } kehillah_spark_refresh_paths_talmudics_effect = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_spark_can_upgrade_talmudics_trigger = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = yes }
			kehillah_spark_upgrade_talmudics_effect = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_ready_told } }
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_talmudics_ready_told value = yes }
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } send_interface_toast = { type = event_toast_text_good title = kehillah_spark_ready_toast_t desc = kehillah_spark_ready_talmudics_toast left_icon = this } }
		}
	}
}
# The Upgrade button (scripted gui kehillah_spark_upgrade_talmudics).
kehillah_spark_upgrade_talmudics_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_spark_talmudics_tier ?= 1 kehillah_spark_can_deepen_talmudics_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_talmudics_tier value = 2 }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } trigger_event = kehillah_spark.0012 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:kehillah_spark_talmudics_tier ?= 2 kehillah_spark_can_be_great_talmudics_trigger = yes }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_talmudics_tier value = 3 }
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } trigger_event = kehillah_spark.0022 }
	}
	remove_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_ready_told
	kehillah_spark_refresh_paths_talmudics_effect = yes
}
# The card's discard button asks first (kehillah_spark.0032).
kehillah_spark_discard_talmudics_effect = { kehillah_spark_clear_talmudics_effect = yes }

# Scope: a writer. An action taken while holding a spark of DISC.
kehillah_spark_mark_route_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_$DISC$_form }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_$DISC$_did_$ROUTE$ value = yes }
		kehillah_spark_ripen_$DISC$_effect = yes
	}
}
# Scope: a writer. A deed sometimes sparks an idea, into an empty slot only.
kehillah_spark_from_deed_sermon_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_sefer_can_write_trigger = yes OR = { AND = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_torah_trigger = yes } AND = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_midrash_trigger = yes } AND = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_ethics_trigger = yes } } }
		random = { chance = 10
			random_list = {
				10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_torah_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_set_torah_effect = { WORK = flag:deed_sermon } }
				10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_parshanut_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_midrash_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_set_midrash_effect = { WORK = flag:deed_sermon } }
				10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_ethics_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_set_ethics_effect = { WORK = flag:deed_sermon } }
			}
		}
	}
}
kehillah_spark_from_deed_ruling_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_sefer_can_write_trigger = yes OR = { AND = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_law_trigger = yes } AND = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_minhag_trigger = yes } AND = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_responsa_trigger = yes } } }
		random = { chance = 10
			random_list = {
				10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_law_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_set_law_effect = { WORK = flag:deed_ruling } }
				10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_minhag_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_set_minhag_effect = { WORK = flag:deed_ruling } }
				10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_responsa_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_set_responsa_effect = { WORK = flag:deed_ruling } }
			}
		}
	}
}
kehillah_spark_from_deed_letter_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_sefer_can_write_trigger = yes NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_responsa_trigger = yes }
		random = { chance = 35
			random_list = {
				10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_talmudics_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_responsa_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_set_responsa_effect = { WORK = flag:deed_letter } }
			}
		}
	}
}
kehillah_spark_from_deed_debate_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_sefer_can_write_trigger = yes OR = { AND = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_disputation_trigger = yes } AND = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_dialogue_trigger = yes } AND = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_systematic_dialogue_trigger = yes } } }
		random = { chance = 10
			random_list = {
				10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_disputation_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_set_disputation_effect = { WORK = flag:deed_debate } }
				10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_dialogue_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_set_dialogue_effect = { WORK = flag:deed_debate } }
				10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_hashkafa_form } kehillah_spark_can_hold_systematic_dialogue_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_set_systematic_dialogue_effect = { WORK = flag:deed_debate } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Scope: the reader, after a first mastery. WORK: flag; TRACK: its discipline.
kehillah_spark_from_study_effect = {
	set_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_src value = $WORK$ }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { local_var:kehillah_spark_src ?= flag:work_rabbenu_hananel local_var:kehillah_spark_src ?= flag:work_rashi_torah local_var:kehillah_spark_src ?= flag:work_rashi_talmud local_var:kehillah_spark_src ?= flag:work_tosafot local_var:kehillah_spark_src ?= flag:work_ibn_ezra_torah local_var:kehillah_spark_src ?= flag:work_ramban_torah local_var:kehillah_spark_src ?= flag:work_sefer_hamivhar local_var:kehillah_spark_src ?= flag:work_maggid_mishneh local_var:kehillah_spark_src ?= flag:work_yefet_commentary local_var:kehillah_spark_src ?= flag:work_salmon_ben_jeroham_commentary } }
		kehillah_spark_commentary_$TRACK$_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_sefer_can_write_trigger = yes }
		# A held slot only sometimes yields a competing idea.
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = kehillah_spark_$TRACK$_form }
			random = { chance = 65 set_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_done value = yes } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { exists = local_var:kehillah_spark_done } local_var:kehillah_spark_src ?= flag:work_tanakh_torah OR = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_torah_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_can_hold_midrash_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_can_hold_poetry_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_can_hold_grammar_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_can_hold_chronicle_trigger = yes } }
			set_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_done value = yes }
			random_list = {
				40 = { trigger = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_torah_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_offer_torah_effect = { WORK = $WORK$ } }
				6 = { trigger = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_midrash_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_offer_midrash_effect = { WORK = $WORK$ } }
				6 = { trigger = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_poetry_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_offer_poetry_effect = { WORK = $WORK$ } }
				6 = { trigger = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_grammar_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_offer_grammar_effect = { WORK = $WORK$ } }
				6 = { trigger = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_chronicle_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_offer_chronicle_effect = { WORK = $WORK$ } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { exists = local_var:kehillah_spark_done } local_var:kehillah_spark_src ?= flag:work_samaritan_pentateuch OR = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_torah_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_can_hold_midrash_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_can_hold_poetry_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_can_hold_grammar_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_can_hold_chronicle_trigger = yes } }
			set_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_done value = yes }
			random_list = {
				40 = { trigger = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_torah_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_offer_torah_effect = { WORK = $WORK$ } }
				6 = { trigger = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_midrash_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_offer_midrash_effect = { WORK = $WORK$ } }
				6 = { trigger = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_poetry_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_offer_poetry_effect = { WORK = $WORK$ } }
				6 = { trigger = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_grammar_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_offer_grammar_effect = { WORK = $WORK$ } }
				6 = { trigger = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_chronicle_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_offer_chronicle_effect = { WORK = $WORK$ } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { exists = local_var:kehillah_spark_done } local_var:kehillah_spark_src ?= flag:work_orit OR = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_torah_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_can_hold_minhag_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_can_hold_midrash_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_can_hold_poetry_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_can_hold_grammar_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_can_hold_chronicle_trigger = yes } }
			set_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_done value = yes }
			random_list = {
				40 = { trigger = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_torah_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_offer_torah_effect = { WORK = $WORK$ } }
				40 = { trigger = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_minhag_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_offer_minhag_effect = { WORK = $WORK$ } }
				6 = { trigger = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_midrash_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_offer_midrash_effect = { WORK = $WORK$ } }
				6 = { trigger = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_poetry_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_offer_poetry_effect = { WORK = $WORK$ } }
				6 = { trigger = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_grammar_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_offer_grammar_effect = { WORK = $WORK$ } }
				6 = { trigger = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_chronicle_trigger = yes } kehillah_spark_offer_chronicle_effect = { WORK = $WORK$ } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { exists = local_var:kehillah_spark_done } local_var:kehillah_spark_src ?= flag:work_tanakh_neviim OR = { kehillah_spark_can_hold_torah_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_can_hold_chronicle_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_can_hold_ethics_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_can_hold_midrash_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_can_hold_poetry_trigger = yes kehillah_spark_can_hold_grammar_trigger = yes } }
			set_local_variable = { name = kehillah_spark_done value = yes }
			random_list = {

	change_variable = { name = kehillah_commentaries_parshanut add = 1 }

}

# Scope: the author finishing a manuscript. A historical author who meets
# his own niche's conditions writes that work, without the quality roll.
kehillah_spark_author_claim_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { kehillah_spark_is_author_of_work_emunot_vedeot_trigger = yes var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:disputation kehillah_writing_disputation_trigger = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_emunot_vedeot_written } rite ?= { kehillah_rite_rabbanite_trigger = yes } learning >= 15 kehillah_writing_believes_thesis_trigger = { TENET = tenet_kehillah_hokhmah } }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_book_named_work value = flag:work_emunot_vedeot }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_writing_landmark value = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_spark_is_author_of_work_chovot_halevavot_trigger = yes var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:ethics kehillah_writing_ethics_trigger = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_chovot_halevavot_written } rite ?= { kehillah_rite_rabbanite_trigger = yes } learning >= 15 kehillah_writing_believes_thesis_trigger = { TENET = tenet_asceticism } }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_book_named_work value = flag:work_chovot_halevavot }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_writing_landmark value = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_spark_is_author_of_work_kuzari_trigger = yes var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:systematic_dialogue kehillah_writing_systematic_dialogue_trigger = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_kuzari_written } kehillah_sefer_ambition_kuzari_trigger = yes kehillah_writing_believes_thesis_trigger = { TENET = tenet_unrelenting_faith } }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_book_named_work value = flag:work_kuzari }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_writing_landmark value = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_spark_is_author_of_work_seder_rav_amram_trigger = yes var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:siddur kehillah_writing_siddur_trigger = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_seder_rav_amram_written } learning >= 15 kehillah_writing_believes_thesis_trigger = { TENET = tenet_kehillah_sacred_liturgy } }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_book_named_work value = flag:work_seder_rav_amram }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_writing_landmark value = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_spark_is_author_of_work_iggeret_rav_sherira_trigger = yes var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:tradition_history kehillah_writing_tradition_history_trigger = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_iggeret_rav_sherira_written } learning >= 15 kehillah_lib_bavli_mastered_count_value >= 2 kehillah_writing_believes_thesis_trigger = { TENET = tenet_religious_legal_pronouncements } }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_book_named_work value = flag:work_iggeret_rav_sherira }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_writing_landmark value = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_spark_is_author_of_work_rabbenu_hananel_trigger = yes var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:talmud kehillah_writing_talmud_trigger = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_rabbenu_hananel_written } learning >= 15 kehillah_lib_bavli_mastered_count_value >= 2 kehillah_writing_believes_thesis_trigger = { TENET = tenet_religious_legal_pronouncements } }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_book_named_work value = flag:work_rabbenu_hananel }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_writing_landmark value = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_spark_is_author_of_work_mekor_hayyim_trigger = yes var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:systematic_dialogue kehillah_writing_systematic_dialogue_trigger = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_mekor_hayyim_written } rite ?= { kehillah_rite_rabbanite_trigger = yes } learning >= 16 knows_language = language_arabic kehillah_writing_believes_thesis_trigger = { TENET = tenet_kehillah_hokhmah } }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_book_named_work value = flag:work_mekor_hayyim }
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_writing_landmark value = yes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_spark_is_author_of_work_kitab_alanwar_trigger = yes var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:disputation kehillah_writing_disputation_trigger = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_kitab_alanwar_written } rite ?= { kehillah_rite_toric_trigger = yes } learning >= 15 kehillah_writing_believes_thesis_trigger = { TENET = tenet_literalism } }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_spark_is_author_of_work_yefet_commentary_trigger = yes var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:torah kehillah_writing_torah_trigger = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_yefet_commentary_written } rite ?= { kehillah_rite_toric_trigger = yes } learning >= 15 kehillah_writing_believes_thesis_trigger = { TENET = tenet_literalism } }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { kehillah_spark_is_author_of_work_rashi_torah_trigger = yes var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:torah kehillah_writing_torah_trigger = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_rashi_torah_written } kehillah_writing_rashi_torah_ready_trigger = yes }

# Scope: the author starting a project. Uses up the chosen form's spark.
kehillah_spark_consume_current_effect = {
	if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:torah } kehillah_spark_clear_parshanut_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:midrash } kehillah_spark_clear_parshanut_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:poetry } kehillah_spark_clear_parshanut_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:grammar } kehillah_spark_clear_parshanut_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:chronicle } kehillah_spark_clear_parshanut_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:talmud } kehillah_spark_clear_talmudics_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:yerushalmi } kehillah_spark_clear_talmudics_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:law } kehillah_spark_clear_talmudics_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:responsa } kehillah_spark_clear_talmudics_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:minhag } kehillah_spark_clear_talmudics_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:siddur } kehillah_spark_clear_talmudics_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:tradition_history } kehillah_spark_clear_talmudics_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:scriptural_law } kehillah_spark_clear_talmudics_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:dialogue } kehillah_spark_clear_hashkafa_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:systematic_dialogue } kehillah_spark_clear_hashkafa_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:mystical } kehillah_spark_clear_hashkafa_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:disputation } kehillah_spark_clear_hashkafa_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:translation } kehillah_spark_clear_hashkafa_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:ethics } kehillah_spark_clear_hashkafa_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { var:kehillah_writing_form ?= flag:devotion } kehillah_spark_clear_hashkafa_effect = yes }
}
